images.title: What does it *cost*?
images.text: The demo and the 20-min intro call are free.
images.answer: If you want a tool built for your team, you get a quote first. No surprises.

images.title: Do I need *coding skills*?
images.text: No. You use the tool – the code is my job.
images.answer: If you can use a spreadsheet, you can use the tool.

images.title: What happens to my *data*?
images.text: The demo runs on sample data only.
images.answer: Never send real company or client data via DM. For a real project, we agree on data handling first.

images.title: Does this replace my *tax software*?
images.answer: My tools close the gaps that end up in spreadsheets – the calcs, checks and reconciliations around it.

images.title: Are you a *CPA*?
images.text: No. I was trained in the German tax administration (3-year civil-service tax degree) and I’m a Certified AI Manager (IHK, German Chamber of Commerce).
images.answer: I build the tools. Your CPA or advisor signs off.
